message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on an MDF "Letters to Santa" box. Candidate headings are 4420 (wooden articles of furniture/ornaments), 9505 (festive articles), and 4421 (other articles of wood).

The ruling probably classified it under 9505.10 as a Christmas decoration, but the description stresses that the box is "utilitarian and designed to hold letters." That points toward heading 4420 or 4421 instead. Heading 4420 covers wood marquetry, caskets and cases for jewelry or cutlery, and statuettes and other ornaments of wood. Boxes of wood fall under 4420.90 or 4420.11/19. Heading 4416 and 4421 also exist, but 4421 is for other articles of wood. Since 4420 covers "caskets and cases for jewelry or cutlery, and similar articles," a box holding letters is arguably similar, though in practice CBP often puts decorative wooden boxes in 4420.90.80.

The alternative is 4421.99.97, for other articles of wood, which includes MDF articles. Because 4420 says "of wood," and MDF is fiberboard of wood, it would normally go to 4421.99 as an article of fiberboard. Fiberboard articles not elsewhere specified go in 4421.99.97 (4421.99.9880 in older schedules). The current structure is 4421.91 for bamboo and 4421.99 for other. Under 4421.99, the 10-digit codes are 4421.99.9880 (other) and 4421.99.9700 or similar. I'll go with 4421.99.9880.
